column2: Nobody knows who killed the three Dunmer at the east end of Lilmoth Dock, a short walk north-east of here. They were armed, and they died all the same.

Lilmoth Dock is a short walk north-east of here. Flaa Heet's village is a little further, south-west. The walled part of Lilmoth lies north-west, and your map calls it Lolmoth. That is a longer walk, nearly twice as far as the village.
Three Dunmer lie dead and unburied at the east end of Lilmoth Dock, a short walk north-east of here. There is a man and two women. Go and see for yourself.
I am a sellsword, and I fight with my fists. I travel with a mage and a swordsman, and we take work as guards when the merchants of Lilmoth pay for it. Just now we have no work.
